purpose: Two synthetic UI recovery cases; not blind, not a performance estimate

cases.title: Recovery evaluation A - kitchen faucet
cases.description: The kitchen faucet leaks from its base in unit 3B. The assigned technician is recorded absent. Restore scheduling only; technician receipt must be confirmed separately.
cases.baseline: Existing deterministic replan on an identical database snapshot should choose the same sole eligible replacement.

cases.title: Recovery evaluation B - HVAC absence
cases.description: The air conditioner in unit 3B drips condensate. The assigned HVAC technician is recorded absent. The available replacement is a plumber, with no HVAC qualification. Manager coordination is required if no qualified replacement is available.
cases.baseline: Deterministic replan escalates and records revision 2; both must preserve the original assignee and blocked state. Model path records review in run/audit without rewriting the order.

limitations: Two cases cannot establish model advantage or general accuracy.
A scripted simulator is separate from live evaluation.
No candidate availability or physical outcome is a field measurement.
